_comment: Copy this file to config.json (next to start.bat) and change what you need. Restart the board afterwards. Lines starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Every value below is the default.
_port: The address is http://<this PC's name>:port. Use a port IT has opened in the firewall.
_host: 0.0.0.0 lets the team reach the board. 127.0.0.1 allows this PC only.
_dataDir: Where board.db lives. A folder path; relative paths start from this folder. Use forward slashes, e.g. D:/EngineeringBoard/data
_backupDir: Where backups go. If you remove this line, they go in a backups folder inside dataDir. Pointing this at a network share or OneDrive folder protects against a dead PC, e.g. //fileserver/engineering/board-backups
_backupKeepDays: Backups older than this are deleted. The newest 7 are always kept.
_restoreUploadMaxMB: Maximum backup file upload, in MiB (1 to 1024). Uploads stream to disk after admin authorization.
_reviewUploadMaxMB: Largest PDF that can be attached for drawing review, in MiB (1 to 2048). Merged signed scans can be large.
_timezone: Decides when a job becomes overdue and what 'today' means.
_hoursPerDay: The reference line on the Workload page. Not a limit.
